# FactCheck

> Splits an AI-generated answer into claims. Facts are supported only by a quoted passage or a tool result. Opinions are reported as what mainstream fact-checkers say, never as true or false. Strength of support is per claim, from the evidence. There is no overall score. This file is a stub. The check API is not live.

The home page offers one free check with no sign-up. The button calls a local stub and returns placeholder results. Nothing is uploaded.

- [Home](index.html): Paste an answer and check it
